findings.label: duplication
findings.failure_mode: Phone number, email, and address are hardcoded as identical literal strings in both Footer.astro and contact.astro with no shared constants module backing either; updating the contact info on the contact page (or vice versa) without also updating the footer leaves the two showing different contact details site-wide.
evidence:
src/components/Footer.astro:12-14 —

Tel: +381 60 000 0000

/ Email: info@boskov.rs / Adresa: Ulica 1, Grad, Srbija
src/pages/contact.astro:11-13 — the identical three literal strings repeated verbatim
src/layouts/Layout.astro:24 — Footer is rendered on every page, so both hardcoded copies ship together with no single source of truth

findings.label: duplication
findings.failure_mode: The name-to-initials computation (split/map/slice/join) is duplicated verbatim in ProductCard.astro and src/pages/products/[id].astro instead of being a shared helper; a future change to the initials rule applied to one copy will silently diverge from the other, producing inconsistent initials between the product list and product detail page.
evidence: src/pages/products/[id].astro:13-17 — identical split/map/slice/join block re-implemented independently
src/pages/products/[id].astro:26 — renders {initials} from the second, independently computed copy
